description: Dept. of Labour - The Cost of Living Index Number for the Month of February 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade is 178.9 and the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of March 2015 for Workers will be Rs. 552.07
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, which is done under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation and application of existing legislation (a statutory instrument), making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it mentions government officials (Director-General of Census and Statistics, Commissioner of Labour), it does so only in their capacity to execute these regulatory functions; the core content is not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
